[b]How to use[/b]

Replace in all files and folders each instance of "Custom Rabbit" with what you want to call your new animal (ex. Pink Rabbit). Don't forget to change the filenames in the assets folder to the same name (ex. "Pink Rabbit.png" and "BabyPink Rabbit.png").

If you want to customize the data entry of the rabbit more, you can use my [url=https://paritee.github.io/?fad=UmFiYml0OjQvNi80NDAvNDQ2L3JhYmJpdC84LzMyLzQ4LzMyLzgvMzIvNDgvMzIvMC9mYWxzZS9Db29wLzE2LzE2LzE2LzE2LzEwLzUvbnVsbC82NDMvODAwMC9SYWJiaXQvQ29vcA==#generate-data-farmanimals-entry]Farm Animal Data Generator Tool[/url]﻿.
